4 افثج i. q. تَرَكَ: (O, K:) you say, أَفْثَجَنِى, meaning He left, or relinquished, me, (تَرَكَنِى,) and left me alone: (O:) and so افسج عَنِّى. (Thus in the O in art. فسج.) ＝
-A2- Also, (S, O, K,) accord. to Ks, (S, O,) like أَفْثَأَ, (TA,) and so أُفْثِجَ, (O, K,) this last, in the pass. form, mentioned by IAar, (TA,) He (a man, TA) was, or became, tired, and out of breath, (S, O, K,) from running. (S, O.) ＝
-A3- See also 1, second sentence.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
